name: 29941-prefill8k-qwen3moe30b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), host DRAM behind PCIe Gen5 x16.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism; 6.75 GiB of expert weights held in host memory by declaration.
architecture: Qwen3MoeForCausalLM sparse MoE, 48 layers, 128 experts per layer, top-8 routing, hidden 2048, moe_intermediate_size 768, 32 Q / 4 KV heads, head_dim 128; bf16, ~30.5 B parameters (~3.3 B active), ~57 GiB of weights.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup 20%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 300 requests with a 1800 s safety cap -> 210 counted requests.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, request_format plain, fixed by construction at 8192 prompt tokens and 1 output token (min=max on both), no shared prefix, seed 29941.
purpose: A document analysis service that reads 8,000-token submissions one at a time on a single GPU with a 30-billion-parameter sparse expert model.
launch:
# ENGINE: commit ed42507f6d6e326663997da5cca6991da5d8a23f, published as the per-commit wheel
# vllm-0.16.0rc2.dev483+ged42507f6. A COMMIT AND NOT A RELEASE -- the v0.16.0 tag is not an
# ancestor of it, so a v0.16.0 build is a sibling tree and not this one. The interpreter and the
# hardware seal are in configs/env.yaml, which is per-machine and NOT portable.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B

tensor-parallel-size: 1

# THE DEPLOYMENT, and fixed. `cpu-offload-gb` is the host-DRAM byte budget; `cpu-offload-params`
# restricts it to parameters whose dotted name carries one of these segments as a whole segment.
# 6.75 GiB is exactly six decoder layers' expert tensors at this checkpoint's shapes (6 x 1152
# MiB), so the budget lands on a layer boundary; everything else stays resident on the card.
# The list is written as JSON: the config reader parses a `[`-leading value with `json.loads` and
# falls back to the bare string when that fails, so an unquoted YAML flow list reaches pydantic as
# the string "[w13_weight, w2_weight]" and the engine never starts.
cpu-offload-gb: 6.75
cpu-offload-params: ["w13_weight", "w2_weight"]

dtype: bfloat16

# LOAD-BEARING: prefix caching is on by default on this engine and a hit would shorten a later
# request's prefill. Off, all 300 requests are full 8192-token prefills.
enable-prefix-caching: false

# Above the 8192-token prompt on purpose, so a wire length a few tokens either side of it cannot
# split one request's prefill across two forwards.
max-num-batched-tokens: 16384

max-num-seqs: 2

# Clears the 8193-token worst case without letting the checkpoint's 40960 window size the KV pool.
max-model-len: 16384

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
